dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmph! Just you watch, I'm not gonna launch it into the air again!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: It's alright, Aino. No matter how far your top flies, I will always be there to catch it.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Also, would you like me to perform a polishing procedure on your spinning top? The impact marks are significant and could interfere with force application.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Whoa... Ineffa, you're amazing! You caught the spinning top even after it went flying...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: This is just a minor task. If Aino requires more assistance, I can also retrieve the kite at the top of the workshop, and recover the Temari stolen by small animals.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Haha... Who would've thought? Looks like toys from Inazuma are a hit here in Nod-Krai too.
